wikipediaSummary.title: A Love Supreme (Chanté Moore album)
wikipediaSummary.extract: A Love Supreme is the second studio album by American singer Chanté Moore. It was released by Silas Records and MCA Records on November 15, 1994, in the United States. The album followed her 1992 debut Precious. For A Love Supreme, Moore reunited with several collaborators from her debut, including Simon Law, who served as the album's primary producer, while also expanding her production team with contributions from Ross Anderson, Jimmy Jam and Terry Lewis, Kipper Jones, and Kuk Harrell.
